dialogues.speaker: Sumi
dialogues.text: Though the resistance is definitely involved with the incident at the Mikage Furnace in some way, the Shogunate's policies are still way too harsh.

dialogues.speaker: Sumi
dialogues.text: I know the difficulties Vision-bearers face. I've taken some in before, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Sumi
dialogues.text: All in all, I don't particularly support either side, but I've chosen to stay here because of my companions.
